description: This file defines the StaticCredentialsProvider class, which provides a static implementation of AWS credentials management in PHP, including setting and retrieving AWS credentials like access key ID, secret access key, and session token.

classes.name: StaticCredentialsProvider
classes.description: Provides a static set of AWS credentials for authentication, extending CredentialsProvider, and manages credentials such as access key, secret key, and session token.
